beats.name: Prancing on the Sand Dunes
beats.prompt: Guide the horse along the backdrop; lift hand rhythmically to trot.

beats.name: Rider's Double Salute
beats.prompt: Pinch with your off-hand to raise the rider's arms in salutation.

beats.name: The Monsoon Clouds Gather
beats.prompt: Sway the horse gently as desert thunder rumbles softly in the distance.

beats.name: Desert Sunrise Gallop
beats.prompt: Gallop forward into the golden morning light as the backdrop illuminates.

beats.name: Curtain of Golden Sands
beats.prompt: Horse and rider bow together to generous courtyard applause.

meetTheMaker.title: Meet the Maker: The Carved Marwari Horse
meetTheMaker.description: The Kathputli Ghodi is renowned for its stylized inward-curving ears—a hallmark of the indigenous Marwari horse breed. Its wooden core is draped in saffron and crimson scraps of fabric salvaged from festive turbans, stitched by hand with mirror-glass and bells.
meetTheMaker.communityDedication: In honour of the Bhat puppeteers who brought legends to the deserts of Rajasthan.
